ValidationRule.description: Block user from manually updating the status to closed from record for TrustMe Cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISNULL( Verified_By__c ), ISBLANK(Verified_By__c) ), ISCHANGED( Status ) , OR( RecordType.DeveloperName == 'TrustMe_eIDV_QA_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'TrustMe_eIDV_Case' ), NOT(IsClosed) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update the case using the Update Status action.
